content:
maya: Postmortem follow-up from the Canary incident — want to capture owners and timelines for the remediation items we sketched in the doc. recurring pattern: config drift + gap in auto-rollback detection.
ben: SGTM. can we list the concrete action items here with owners? short deadlines preferred.
sam: I can own the auto-rollback tuning work. will need 2 weeks to prototype threshold changes and a dry-run.
maya: Action 1: Auto-rollback detection improvements. Owner: sam. Deliverable: prototype + dry-run on staging. ETA: 2025-03-24. Priority: P0.
ben: Action 2: Blast-radius caps for canaries (per-cluster cap + global cap). Owner: ben. Deliverable: policy + rollout plan + flag gating. ETA: 2025-03-17. Priority: P0.
olivia: Action 3: Postmortem-driven feature-flag hygiene (mandatory kill-switch for risky flags). Owner: olivia. Deliverable: policy doc + sample FF config + training for eng squads. ETA: 2025-03-31. Priority: P1.
maya: Also adding Action 4: Recurring incident pattern tracker — implement a simple dashboard that surfaces flags/rollouts correlated with incidents. Owner: maya. ETA: 2025-04-07. Priority: P1.
sam: For auto-rollback, I propose we add two signals: error-rate spike > 5x baseline for 2 minutes OR p50 latency > 3x baseline for 60s. auto-rollback only if both signals persist for the window. This reduces flaps.
ben: Sounds reasonable. can we express policy as a small policy config?
sam: yes, rough example:
```json
{
  "policy_name": "canary_auto_rollback_v1",
  "signals": [
    {"metric": "errors_per_minute", "factor": 5, "window_s": 120},
    {"metric": "p50_latency_ms", "factor": 3, "window_s": 60}
  ],
  "require_all": true,
  "min_sample_count": 20,
  "actions": ["rollback", "alert#oncall"]
}
```
maya: We should keep a safety cap on blast radius regardless of metrics — e.g., max 0.5% of total users or 3 instances, whichever is smaller.
ben: I'll draft the gating rules and a feature-flag schema to enforce caps. example flag snippet I'll use for rollout:
```yaml
feature_flag: rollouts/canary_experiment
targeting:
  percent: 0.5
  clusters: ["canary-1", "canary-2"]
safety:
  max_instances: 3
  auto_rollback_policy: canary_auto_rollback_v1
```
ben: Plan to add enforcement in the control plane so any rollout that violates safety caps is rejected.
maya: Good. add an audit log + alert to the oncall channel when a rollout is started and when it's rejected.
olivia: For the FF hygiene training, I'll prep a 30m session and a short checklist for PR reviewers. also link remediation owners in the checklist.
sam: one more operational note — when auto-rollback triggers, we should attach the last 1k tokens of logs and a sampling of requests to the incident ticket to speed triage.
maya: Agree. Action 5: Logging slice on rollback events. Owner: sam. ETA: 2025-03-24.
ben: I'll own the rollout enforcement PRs and console UI changes. Action 6: Console flag/status indicator + quick rollback button. ETA: 2025-03-31.
maya: I'll track all of these in a lightweight tracker — adding tickets now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421 (auto-rollback), INF-3422 (blast-radius caps), INF-3423 (FF hygiene), INF-3424 (incident-dashboard), INF-3425 (rollback-logs), INF-3426 (console-ui).
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started by ben at 2025-03-11T14:03:02Z — id=canary-20250311-01
ben: Noted — I'll wait to add enforcement until after I push the first PR but will add the server-side reject rule in that PR.
olivia: Do we want an immediate short-term mitigation before the new policies land? e.g., manual pre-deploy checklist for any rollout >0.2%?
sam: Good call. temporary rule: any rollout >0.2% requires a signoff from platform + oncall. We can add a pre-deploy check in the pipeline. Owner: ben. ETA: 48h.
maya: OK put that in as a short-term action: Action 7: pre-deploy signoff gate for >0.2%. Owner: ben. ETA: 2025-03-13. Priority: P0.
ben: I'll add the pipeline hook and a small UI prompt for signoff.
maya: I'll follow up with weekly check-ins until all P0s are closed. next sync: 2025-03-14 09:30 PT.
olivia: thanks — will update the product teams.
sam: starting the auto-rollback prototype tomorrow. will post a PR link when available.
ben: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/882 — draft for blast-radius enforcement (WIP).
maya: Great. closing this thread for now but will reopen if blockers pop up. please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept ownership of the items assigned to you.
ben: :white_check_mark:
sam: :white_check_mark:
olivia: :white_check_mark:
maya: last_message: follow-up note: if anyone sees the same pattern in other incidents, append to INF-3424 so we can look for clusters.
